messages:
divya: Quick sync — proposing DP tiers + feedback SLAs. Draft below. TL;DR: 3 tiers (Light, Core, Embedded). SLAs: 48h for triage, 5 business days for prioritized fix, weekly summary. Thoughts? /cc @jason @liam @sarah
jason: quick q — how do we measure 'triage'? is it ack or initial reply?
divya: good q — triage = initial reply acknowledging issue + owner. should be within 48h during business days. add timezone note for APAC.
liam: for Core tier can we promise 24h triage? might be necessary for low-latency customers. worried about engineering load.
sarah: +1 to 24h for Core if we have a rota. ops: can we automate initial ack via bot?
ops-bot: Deploying DP-ACK-bot to channels. /automation will post "Acknowledged — assigned to X" when issue created. ETA Thu.
divya: adding ack bot helps but still need human follow-up. propose: Light = 48h triage, Core = 24h triage + weekly sync, Embedded = 4h triage + bi-weekly on-call.
jason: Embedded 4h is tight. Maybe Embedded = 8h? 4h requires 24/7 on-call for small team.
liam: Agree with 8h. Also, add SLAs for feedback processing: time to incorporate feedback into roadmap grooming. propose: 2 sprints for prioritized asks, 4+ for backlog.
divya: noted. Draft SLA table:
```
Tier | Triage | Fix SLA (prio) | Roadmap window
Light | 48h | 2-4 sprints | Quarterly review
Core | 24h | 1-2 sprints | Rolling monthly sync
Embedded | 8h | 1 sprint | Direct weekly sync
```
sarah: looks good. Also need opt-out clause for infra incidents and release freezes.
marta (Legal): legal note — include data handling addendum and optional NDA for Embedded. Also clarify IP of co-developed eval assets.
divya: good call. I'll add NDA + DP Data Addendum templates.
liam: recruitment side — recommend capacity cap: max 8 Embedded partners at once. resource constraints.
divya: ok set cap to 6 for launch. we'll build monitoring to measure load.
sarah: how do we capture feedback? propose: structured feedback form + weekly 30m review. store in /dp-feedback dataset.
divya: exactly — use form + weekly review + short eval prompt suite. add "repro steps" field in form.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: create /dp-feedback repo and a GH project. ETA Fri EOD.
divya: next steps: finalize SLA doc, legal templates, ops automation, recruit outreach script. I'll draft by Tue. volunteers for review?
jason: I can review SLAs.
marta (Legal): I'll review templates.
liam: happy to help ops integration.
sarah: I'll own feedback form and prompts.
divya: thanks team :raised_hands: I'll ping again with draft link.
